note: Read by 3ds/tools/azt.ps1. debug = the -Debug switch string of run_azahar.ps1, until = its -Until regex, cap = -Timeout in s, extra = more run_azahar.ps1 switches. first_marker is a log regex that must appear within deadline s after the Azahar start. expects = warp | tour | none (warp and tour turn on the attract-loop check). expected_events are log regexes that must all appear. status = verified | unverified | completion_only | fail_demo | pending.

scenarios.name: house_sign
scenarios.subject: Mario House sign in the yard (kmr_20, entry 4), close-up by camboom=40 (camera boom length). The sign must read in the shot.
scenarios.proves: Would prove the Mario House sign texture draws.
scenarios.reason: Open. camboom=40 (a boom length set on nextRig and prevRig, debug only) did not change the view (run 6, azt2): the shot is the same wide yard view. The sign is not readable at 240x400. The camera is reset by the game each frame. The debug switch was reverted (not committed). Needs a camera target or zoom path that the game does not overwrite, or a sign position from a map dump.
